reviews.title: “Free Trial” is bull
reviews.text:
They have a THREE day free “trial” but you can’t actually use the number for getting verification codes. Not even ONCE. It tells you the message can only be revealed AFTER the trial period!! What’s the point of the trial period the? 

Also it’s incredibly buggy for an app that requires a monthly fee of 13.99. Why does the screens flicker between what I was on to what I’m going to. As if it’s confused on which screen I’m trying to look at. It happens for about 2-3 seconds and then it sorts itself out. 

Terrible app all around. DONT USE IT purely based on the fact that their “free trial” is so incredibly scummy of them to offer but can’t try out features to see if you want to pay for it??
